I put a clarification for EIP-3540 (EOFv1): https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/5878

This is also a functional change because of geth implementation differs and therefore geth stance is reflected in the  state tests. So I assume many implementations followed this.

I propose to discuss it mainly in the PR. You may want to check your implementation and check if the new variant would improved code quality/clarity.

excerpts.author: chfast
excerpts.content: I will propose one more change to EIP-3540 after. Briefly forbid creating legacy contracts from EOF1 contracts (EOF1 ⥇ legacy).
